sql.query: SELECT statement_revision,key,text FROM task_requirement_versions WHERE task_id=? AND key=? ORDER BY statement_revision
SELECT task_id,statement_revision,key,application_id FROM application_task_links WHERE task_id=? AND key=? ORDER BY statement_revision,application_id
SELECT system_id,application_id FROM system_application_versions WHERE application_id=? AND valid_to IS NULL ORDER BY system_id
SELECT task_id,statement_revision,key,application_id FROM application_task_links WHERE application_id=? ORDER BY task_id,statement_revision,key
SELECT id,revision,status,text,owner_revision FROM requirement_revisions WHERE id=? ORDER BY revision
